description: Renders a styled <span> element for displaying short status text, labels, or counts. It is a static, non-interactive component with no built-in ARIA role. When used to convey meaningful status, consumers must add appropriate ARIA attributes.

focus.notes: Badge is not focusable by default as it is a static display element. If wrapped in an interactive element, focus is managed by the parent.

announcements: The text content of the badge is read as part of the normal document flow
screenReader.notes: Because the badge is a plain span, screen readers treat it as inline text. If the badge conveys dynamic status information, consumers should use aria-label or aria-live regions to ensure updates are announced.

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for all variants)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for border and background)

consumerResponsibilities: Use aria-label if the badge conveys status that is not clear from surrounding context
When badge indicates a count (e.g. notifications), ensure it is associated with its parent via aria-describedby
Do not rely on color alone to convey meaning — include text content
